name: The Last Ringing
source:
A man walking into his house after the work. Man tunring on his gaming console and playing the video game. But suddenly, he is hearing the old phone ringing. The only old phone he have, is not working one. But this phone is just start working. The phone was laying on the table near the console, and doesn't have a power supply. The man picked up a phone. He hears the low voice saying: ???

[From [url=https://alexstrange.itch.io/the-last-ringing]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名男子下班后走进自己的家。男人打开游戏机玩电子游戏。但突然，他听到旧电话铃声响起。他唯一的旧手机已经坏了。但这款手机才刚刚开始工作。手机放在控制台附近的桌子上，没有电源。那人拿起电话。他听到低沉的声音说：？？？

[来自[url=https://alexstrange.itch.io/the-last-ringing]Itch.io[/url]]
